diagnostics.message: The operation id listTasks of /surfaces/app/routes/listTasks is also the id of /surfaces/app/routes/tasks/ops/0; operation ids are unique across the api.
diagnostics.fix: Rename one of the routes, or set operationId on one of them.

diagnostics.message: The operation list_tasks of /surfaces/app/routes/archive has the same name words as listTasks of /surfaces/app/routes/tasks/ops/0, so the two collide in every language.
diagnostics.fix: Rename one of the routes, or set operationId on one of them.

diagnostics.message: The collection logs declares neither singular nor id, so the operation at /surfaces/app/routes/logs/ops/create has no singular noun for its name.
diagnostics.fix: Set singular on the collection (or declare its id).
